generalist.name: Agsoy, Jay Mark V.
generalist.major: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
generalist.summary: Builds systems that work and stay working — from web apps to ML pipelines, from APIs to reverse engineering tools.
generalist.bio: Computer Science student at the University of Mindanao. I don't chase hype — I build things that hold up. Web, AI, systems, whatever the stack demands. Certified in Database and Network Security.

whatIDo.title: Web & Systems
whatIDo.description: Full-stack development with modern frameworks. REST APIs, databases, authentication. I care about things staying up, not just going up.

whatIDo.title: AI & Orchestration
whatIDo.description: LLM-powered applications, TTS pipelines, recommendation systems. I wire models together into things people can actually use.

whatIDo.title: Reverse Engineering
whatIDo.description: Ghidra, x64dbg, decompilers. Understanding how things work from the inside out. Built tools for static analysis and binary inspection.

whatIDo.title: Creative Tech
whatIDo.description: Live2D, game development, digital music production. Code that intersects with art and expression.

philosophy: I believe working code beats perfect architecture.
Every decision should be reversible. Complexity is a liability until proven necessary.
Ship the smallest thing that solves the problem, then iterate.
I'm drawn to systems thinking — understanding how pieces fit together, where the failure points are, and what happens when things break.
I'd rather spend an hour preventing a bug than a day fixing one.

web-dev.name: Agsoy, Jay Mark V.
web-dev.major: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
web-dev.summary: Builds full-stack web applications with clean architecture, REST APIs, and responsive frontends. From database schemas to deployment.
web-dev.tagline: Ship clean, ship working, ship often.
web-dev.bio: Computer Science student at the University of Mindanao. I build full-stack web apps — from database schemas to responsive UIs. I care about maintainability, security, and code that stays up. Certified in Database fundamentals.

whatIDo.title: Full-Stack Applications
whatIDo.description: End-to-end web applications built with Node.js, PHP, and modern JavaScript. REST APIs with Express and Laravel, databases with MySQL and SQLite. I wire the frontend to the backend and make sure data flows cleanly.

whatIDo.title: Frontend & UI
whatIDo.description: Responsive interfaces with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Vue, and Tailwind. I care about the user experience, not just the component tree. Dark mode, accessibility, and sensible defaults.

whatIDo.title: Backend & Infrastructure
whatIDo.description: Server-side logic, authentication, file handling, and deployment. Docker containers, SQL schemas, and API design. I build backends that don't fall over when someone actually uses them.

philosophy: Working code beats perfect architecture. You can refactor a shipped feature, you can't refactor a vaporware spec.
A REST API is a contract. Once someone depends on it, changing it breaks their trust. Design carefully, version honestly.
The best code is the code you don't write. Use the framework, don't fight it.
Security is not a feature. It's how you write code. Input validation, parameterized queries, least privilege — every time.

security-re.name: Agsoy, Jay Mark V.
security-re.major: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
security-re.summary: Breaks things down to understand how they work. Static analysis, dynamic analysis, encryption, and low-level tooling. From hex signatures to network traffic.
security-re.bio: Computer Science student at the University of Mindanao. I analyze systems from the binary up — reverse engineering game assets, building file identification tools, and securing data with zero-knowledge encryption. Certified in Network Security.

whatIDo.title: Reverse Engineering
whatIDo.description: Static and dynamic analysis with Ghidra, x64dbg, and IDA. I trace error strings, map call trees, and understand how binaries work from the inside out. Built tools for .ido game asset decompilation and hex signature identification.

whatIDo.title: Security Tooling
whatIDo.description: Self-hosted encrypted file vaults with zero-knowledge architectures. AES-256-CBC, 3-tier access control, circuit breaker patterns for fault tolerance. I build things that stay secure even when the server is compromised.

whatIDo.title: Network & Systems
whatIDo.description: Intrusion detection with ML, network traffic analysis, and protocol understanding. I work with Wireshark, evaluate IDS models across legacy and IoT datasets, and understand how data moves between systems.

philosophy: Trust nothing, verify everything. Every input is an attack until proven otherwise.
Understanding how things break is how you make them unbreakable. I don't just use tools — I take them apart.
Encryption is not magic. It's math with operational constraints. Zero-knowledge means designing a system where the server doesn't need to be trusted, not just saying it.
A security tool nobody can use is useless. The best defense is the one that gets deployed.

ai-ml.name: Agsoy, Jay Mark V.
ai-ml.major: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
ai-ml.summary: Builds ML pipelines, LLM-powered applications, and recommendation systems. Models are tools — the system around them matters more.
ai-ml.tagline: Models are tools. Systems are the product.
ai-ml.bio: Computer Science student at the University of Mindanao. I work at the intersection of ML and systems engineering — building recommendation engines, intrusion detection models, and LLM-powered assistants. I care about models that ship, not just models that score well on a test set.

whatIDo.title: ML Systems
whatIDo.description: End-to-end ML pipelines from data preprocessing to model evaluation. k-NN recommendation over 2,600-dim feature spaces, cross-dataset evaluation for IDS models, and CatBoost for categorical feature engineering.

whatIDo.title: LLM Applications
whatIDo.description: Multi-provider LLM orchestration with intelligent routing, circuit breaker fault tolerance, and persistent memory. Built a four-component AI assistant system connecting LLM APIs, TTS, and Live2D character rendering.

whatIDo.title: Data Engineering
whatIDo.description: Feature engineering, TF-IDF vectorization, one-hot encoding, and handling real-world data issues — missing values, label inconsistencies, and distribution shift across datasets.

philosophy: Models are tools. The system around the model matters more than the model itself. A 70% accurate model in production beats 95% in a notebook.
Data quality > model architecture. Clean data with a simple model outperforms dirty data with SOTA every time.
Distribution shift is the silent killer. A model that works on your training set but fails in production isn't a model — it's a demo.
LLMs are powerful but unreliable. Design your system to assume the model will fail sometimes, and handle it gracefully.
